errorPredicates.CSRF_INVALID: Before command: OWNER_SESSION mutation token absent or fails actual frozen CSRF verifier; API channel does not inherit a session-only requirement.
errorPredicates.CURSOR_INVALID: Opaque cursor missing, unavailable under effective retention or does not belong to authenticated OWNER.
errorPredicates.CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH: Cursor channel/current-session/query/page-policy binding differs from the frozen immutable snapshot.
errorPredicates.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: Required authentic policy/read/context/persistence dependency cannot be obtained; retain actual attempt classification, no guessed effect and no terminal business outcome.
errorPredicates.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Retained scope/key exists but exact canonical semantic request bytes/digest differ.
errorPredicates.INVALID_REQUEST: Before command: wrong closed path/query/header/body mask, duplicate query/header or any body bytes; no business slot allocated.
errorPredicates.REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Before command: OWNER_SESSION mutation fails actual frozen reauthentication strength/age policy; fixture age is not normative.
errorPredicates.SESSION_ALREADY_REVOKED: Locked selected row revokedAt is non-null; exact retained same-command replay is handled before new admission.
errorPredicates.SESSION_EPOCH_INVALIDATED: Locked selected sessionEpoch differs from locked current owner session_epoch.
errorPredicates.SESSION_EXPIRED: Locked selected expiresAt is not strictly after trusted acceptance time.
errorPredicates.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: Locked selected id absent or not owned by authenticated OWNER.
errorPredicates.SIDE_EFFECT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Actual commit outcome cannot be established; FAILED public presentation, UNKNOWN classification/nonterminal retained reconciliation; not an automatic retry.
errorPredicates.STATE_VERSION_CONFLICT: Selected current session stateVersion differs from expectedStateVersion or guarded update affects zero rows.
errorPredicates.UNAUTHENTICATED: Before command/replay: current OWNER credential unavailable, expired, revoked, epoch-invalid or failed trusted caller/channel verification; no fabricated business ID.
